name: IRNSS-1L (NVS-03)
location_str: Satish Dhawan Space Centre Second Launch Pad @ Satish Dhawan Space Centre, IND
slot_a_text: Some rocket engines can restart in space, allowing one launch to send satellites into several different orbits.
slot_b_text: The 3rd launch of the year for India's ISRO, 101st all time. Worldwide, it is attempt number 254 of the year.
description: This is a replacement satellite for the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System. The constellation will provide India with an alternative to GPS and will be used for military and civilian use. Located at a geosynchronous orbit, the system will be operated by the Indian government.
rocket_fact: Some rocket engines can restart in space, allowing one launch to send satellites into several different orbits.
